3.note: written 08-30 off week-2 actuals. All five sessions logged, no pain note, so the heavy week runs. Where the actuals beat the plan, week 3 steps off the actual: back squat volume 280 → 285 (he ran 280 against a 275 prescription, and 82% of the 345 TM is 283), front squat 250 → 255 for 2×2 (he ran 2×3 @ 250 against a 240 prescription — the wave's 88% is 251, so the step is small and the rep drop carries the intensity), hang clean 205 → 235 (he ran 225s all four sets against a 215 plan), clean pull 285, snatch pull 225, pulldown 130 → 165 (he loaded 160 × 10 unprompted, over both the plan and the range). The C&J holds at 250 rather than taking the wave's 93–95% (~260): he made 250 on the third attempt after two misses, and a missed top single does not advance — 255 is available only if 250 goes up crisp first try. Two in-gym notes are now programmed, not just noted: the snatch warmup complex is 5×2 (two sets each at 115 and 135) because he said twice he needs the doubled bottom weights to get warm, and the rack jerk gets a fifth warmup double at 240 because the 225 → top-single jump was too big. The Thu cable crunch is written as "cable crunch or hanging knee raise" — the station was occupied wk2 and he swapped. Volume takes the +1 everywhere it was earned: hams 7 → 8 (Sat curl 3 → 4, load holding at 90 with reps at the bottom of range), upper back 7 → 8 (rear-delt 3 → 4), abs 12 → 13 (Mon HKR 4), lats 5 → 6, chest 14 → 15, one below the meso's hard cap. Glutes stay at 3 per the landmark table's own ramp; the hip thrust load goes 290 → 305 on three clean sets of 10.
